verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a Personnel object with custom fields and access reviews where reviewers can mark accounts revoked, with follow-up tasks synced to ticketing tools. That gives some building blocks for proving a leaver lost access. However, nothing in the evidence describes HR-synced onboarding or offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking, or offboarding-triggered access removal; these reviews are periodic rather than tied to hire or leave events. Missing for 10: HR system integration driving personnel lifecycle, onboarding checklists with security training tracking, offboarding checklists that verify access deprovisioning, independent corroboration.
